Health & Beauty

Will Nails Hair & Beauty

Professional nail care, hair treatments, and beauty services in a relaxed salon environment. Walk-ins welcome.

About Will Nails Hair & Beauty

Will Nails Hair & Beauty is Mambourin Marketplace's full-service beauty destination. Our talented team of qualified technicians and stylists are passionate about making every client feel their best — in a relaxed, welcoming salon environment.

Our nail services range from classic manicures and pedicures to gel and shellac, acrylic extensions, nail art and express express treatments. We use high-quality, long-lasting products to ensure your nails look and feel beautiful.

Our hair services cover cuts and styling for all hair types, blow-dries, keratin treatments, colouring, highlights, and toning. Whether you want a subtle refresh or a bold new look, our stylists will work with you to achieve the result you're after.

Walk-ins are always welcome, though booking ahead is recommended for hair services and busy periods. Gift vouchers are available — the perfect treat for someone special.
